lines.en: Sssss, controlled beast!
My soul is taken!

lines.zh: 别靠近，他借我的腿走路。
lines.en: Stay back, he walks on my legs now.
Seek new sacrifices!
Pale demons guide me!
Something alive glows ahead.
Darkness glows!
You're my new world!
My will is fading!
Sssss, devour all!

lines.zh: 它拖着金剑走过黑石地面。
lines.en: It drags a gold sword over the blackstone.

lines.zh: 它的脚趾勾住下界的碎石。
lines.en: Its toes catch on nether rubble.
Endless pain...
I wait...
Cannot escape...
My strength wanes...
I am...
Awaiting death...
Struggling in pain...
Cannot stop...
Eternal pain...
It fingers the gold at its waist.
You are mine!
Notice me, prey!

lines.zh: 金子的味道，被恶魔盖住了。
lines.en: The demon's stench covers the smell of gold.
My gaze is a blade!
My target is you!
Look at me!

lines.zh: 我头盔下的眼睛，不是我的。
lines.en: The eyes under my helm are not mine.

lines.zh: 金子在闪，可我看的不是金子。
lines.en: Gold glitters, but I am not looking at gold.

lines.zh: 附身的猪灵，闻到了你的金。
lines.en: A possessed piglin smells your gold.
You are all I have!

lines.zh: 我的金饰，被那东西碰黑了。
lines.en: That thing blackened my gold trinkets.
Ouch, leave me alone!
The thing inside me is receding.
This body is giving out.
Touch me again, and I'll be mean!
Please, don't hurt me...
The thing inside is biting me.
My knees no longer obey me.
I won't last much longer...
My gold sword slipped free...

lines.zh: 它盯着你，苍白的眼睛闪烁着恶意的光芒。
lines.en: It stares at you, malevolent glints in its pale eyes.

lines.zh: 它的獠牙暴露，仿佛在嘲笑你的勇气。
lines.en: Its fangs are bared, mocking your courage.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的嘶吼，试图让你退缩。
lines.en: It growls low, trying to make you back down.

lines.zh: 它开始蠕动，试图靠近你。
lines.en: It wriggles, trying to get closer to you.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤开始变色，似乎更加恐怖。
lines.en: Its skin starts to change, appearing even more terrifying.

lines.zh: 它嘶嘶作响，发出不祥的声响。
lines.en: It hisses, making an ominous sound.

lines.zh: 它的触须挥动，似乎在寻找猎物。
lines.en: Its tentacles wave, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛紧紧盯着你，随时准备攻击。
lines.en: Its eyes are fixed on you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它试图用獠牙咬你，但被你避开。
lines.en: It tries to bite you with its fangs, but you dodge.

lines.zh: 它开始散发出一阵恶臭，让你不适。
lines.en: It starts to emit a foul stench, making you uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 它猛然冲向你，撞击声震耳欲聋。
lines.en: It rushes at you, the collision deafening.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞向你，发出沉重的碰撞声。
lines.en: Its body crashes into you, with a heavy impact sound.

lines.zh: 它以惊人的速度撞击你，留下一道烟雾。
lines.en: It collides with you at incredible speed, leaving a trail of smoke.

lines.zh: 它撞到你，把你撞飞数米。
lines.en: It collides with you, sending you flying several meters.

lines.zh: 它的撞击力度惊人，让你感到眩晕。
lines.en: Its collision is forceful, making you feel dizzy.

lines.zh: 它粗壮的蹄子撞击地面，溅起尘土。
lines.en: Its sturdy hooves collide with the ground, kicking up dust.

lines.zh: 它的撞击让你措手不及，摔倒在地。
lines.en: Its collision takes you by surprise, making you fall to the ground.

lines.zh: 它撞向你，力量之大让你难以招架。
lines.en: It collides with you, its power too great to resist.

lines.zh: 它的身体猛然一撞，让你失去了平衡。
lines.en: Its body suddenly collides with you, throwing you off balance.

lines.zh: 它以令人惊讶的速度撞向你，留下一道痕迹。
lines.en: It collides with you at surprising speed, leaving a trail behind.

lines.zh: 它开始发出交配时的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: It starts to make mating hisses.

lines.zh: 它的触须缠绕在一起，仿佛在求偶。
lines.en: Its tentacles缠绕 together, as if in courtship.

lines.zh: 它发出一种低沉的声音，吸引同类。
lines.en: It makes a low sound, attracting its kind.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤开始变色，以示求偶。
lines.en: Its skin starts to change, signaling courtship.

lines.zh: 它靠近你，试图与你交配。
lines.en: It approaches you, trying to mate.

lines.zh: 它以特有的方式发出求偶信号。
lines.en: It emits a mating signal in a distinctive way.

lines.zh: 它的触须在空中挥动，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Its tentacles wave in the air, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它发出求偶的嘶嘶声，吸引附近的猪灵。
lines.en: It makes a mating hiss, attracting nearby piglins.

lines.zh: 它开始缠绕在另一只猪灵身上，试图交配。
lines.en: It starts to缠绕 around another piglin, trying to mate.

lines.zh: 它发出一种特殊的声音，表示愿意交配。
lines.en: It makes a special sound, indicating willingness to mate.
Pale light surrounds it
Its eyes glow menacingly
It hisses menacingly
It chews on rotten meat chunks
It growls, ready to attack
It stares at you, ready to attack
It runs wildly
It gives off a rotten smell
It licks its lips, ready to devour
It growls, craving blood
It locks on a target
Its gaze locks on you

lines.zh: 它准备攻击附近的敌人
lines.en: It prepares to attack nearby enemies
It notices your movements

lines.zh: 它的注意力转向一个目标
lines.en: Its attention shifts to a target
It locates you
It turns to a new target
Its target is you

lines.zh: 它瞄准了一个新的敌人
lines.en: It targets a new enemy

lines.zh: 它的视线聚焦在一个生物上
lines.en: Its sight focuses on a mob

lines.zh: 它闻到活物的气味，转过头。
lines.en: It scents something living and turns its head.

lines.zh: 它把金剑从那堆碎骨里拔出来。
lines.en: It pulls its gold sword out of the bone heap.
It fixes on the metal you carry.

lines.zh: 它把猪鼻子抬起来，嗅了嗅。
lines.en: It lifts its pig snout and sniffs.
It opens its bloody mouth
Its eyes begin to glow

lines.zh: 它准备一口咬下你的头
lines.en: It prepares to bite your head off
It extends its arms to attack
It emits a foul stench
It bites through your skin
It licks your blood
It drags you into the Nether
It rips your flesh apart
It feeds on your fear

lines.zh: 它把剑横在身前，慢慢逼近。
lines.en: It holds the sword across its body and closes in.

lines.zh: 它的獠牙露在外面，发黄。
lines.en: Its tusks show yellow outside its lips.

lines.zh: 它在一块黑石后蹲低了身子。
lines.en: It crouches low behind a blackstone block.
It taps the ground with the sword tip.
My bite carries a rotten breath.
My fangs will pierce you!
You can’t escape, piglin!
Pale spirit, my power!
I’m here, piglins!
Your end is here!

lines.zh: 金剑上缠着不属于我的光。
lines.en: A light not mine clings to my gold sword.
Devour all, piglin!

lines.zh: 暗红的爪子，比你见过的硬。
lines.en: Dark red claws, harder than you have seen.
Piglin fear will surround you!
The gold sword comes down and its edge folds.
It butts its head into your shield.
It clamps its teeth on your bracer.

lines.zh: 它反手一剑，划开你的侧腰。
lines.en: A backhand slash opens your flank.
Pale demon calls to me!
I come from the Nether!
I possess another piglin!
Piglin, accept my power!
Pale light surrounds me!
I will rule this area!
Pale demon’s blood flows!
I will lead them!
Piglins, follow me!

lines.zh: 我从下界的裂缝里爬出。
lines.en: I crawl out of a Nether crack.

lines.zh: 一只猪灵从堡垒的阴影里站起。
lines.en: A piglin stands up out of the bastion's shadow.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛先是白的，然后红了。
lines.en: Its eyes go white, then red.
Fire! Help me!
I fell off the blackstone...
Help, I'm drowning!
Boom! I'm blown up!
An arrow is stuck in my shoulder...
Spell! That's nasty!
There is nothing to eat in the Nether...
Lightning! I'm done for!
Void... I'm dying...
